verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a fair question for a GPU cloud platform, for example through versioned launch templates or infrastructure configs. However, the evidence only documents adjacent building blocks: a REST API, launch-time cloud-init configuration, and filesystems for backing up system state. None of these is a versioned, reviewable, roll-back-able automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
